title: Anvil break
description: This data pack will fix this issue, as now fragile blocks that previously broke under an anvil will crumble under it!
body:
Were you annoyed that an anvil, a supposedly heavy block, would break against a light flower or water lily, or even fail to penetrate foliage? This data pack will fix this issue, as now fragile blocks that previously broke under an anvil will crumble under it! Glass and foliage will also break under the weight of this iron.
If any blocks fail to break, please report the error in the comments!
